definitions.explanation: an informal expression of agreement, approval, or acceptance; casual variant of オーケー (okay)

examples.japanese: これでオッケーだと{思|おも}う。

notes:
CASUAL EXPRESSION:
オッケー is a casual, slightly playful variant of オーケー (OK). It's commonly used in informal conversation, especially among younger speakers.

USAGE PATTERNS:
- オッケー！ - OK! (as an interjection)
- ～でオッケー - ～ is okay/fine
- オッケー{出|だ}す - to give approval/the OK

FORMALITY NOTE:
オッケー is quite casual. In formal or business settings, use {大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}です, {構|かま}いません, or {承知|しょうち}しました instead.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- オーケー - OK (slightly more standard spelling)
- {了解|りょうかい} - understood/roger
- {大丈夫|だいじょうぶ} - all right, fine
